# Zana 2.19 documentation

> Zana is a modular PHP 8.5 framework for business applications: modules with Domain, Application,
> Infrastructure and Presentation layers, an explicit dependency injection container validated at
> startup, and packages for HTTP, routing, console, database, security, views and more. These pages
> document Zana 2.19; every code example in them is tested against that release.

In a Zana application, `php bin/console inspect` and `php bin/console check` (with `--format=json`)
show the application and verify it; `AGENTS.md` at its root states its rules.

## Start here

- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/getting-started.md): This guide builds a small but complete Zana application.
- [Working with AI coding agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/ai-agents.md): Zana 2.7 helps AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor and others) work on a Zana application the way its developers do.
- [Deployment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/deployment.md): This page puts a Zana website on a server.
- [Upgrading from 1.x](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/upgrading.md): Zana 1.x shipped three packages.
- [Release notes — Zana 2](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/release-notes.md): Zana 2.0 turns the three 1.x packages into a framework of 19 packages for modular business applications, on PHP 8.5.

## Guides

- [Audit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/guides/audit.md): `mj-zana/audit` (2.2) keeps the revisions of edited content.
- [Cache](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/guides/cache.md): `mj-zana/cache` provides PSR-16 caches with a few additions.
- [Communication: email](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/guides/communication.md): `mj-zana/communication` sends email through Symfony Mailer transports, with safe sender rules and a recorder for tests.
- [Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/guides/configuration.md): `mj-zana/configuration` merges settings from PHP files, the environment and `.env` into one read-only, typed configuration.
- [Console](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/guides/console.md): `mj-zana/console` runs Symfony Console commands with two additions.
- [Container](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/guides/container.md): `mj-zana/container` creates your services and wires their dependencies.
- [Application and modules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/guides/core.md): `mj-zana/core` turns packages and modules into a running application.
- [Database](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/guides/database.md): `mj-zana/database` provides PDO connections, a query builder, a schema builder, module-aware migrations and a transactional unit of work.
- [Domain-driven design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/guides/ddd.md): `mj-zana/ddd` provides the building blocks for a domain model.
- [Events](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/guides/events.md): `mj-zana/events` is a PSR-14 event dispatcher.
- [Filesystem](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/guides/filesystem.md): `mj-zana/filesystem` puts local and in-memory storage behind one interface, `FilesystemInterface`.
- [HTTP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/guides/http.md): `mj-zana/http` handles PSR-7 requests through a PSR-15 middleware pipeline.
- [Idempotency](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/guides/idempotency.md): `mj-zana/idempotency` (2.14) lets a client retry a request that must not run twice.
- [Logging](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/guides/logging.md): `mj-zana/logging` is a PSR-3 logger with handlers, formatters and a shared context.
- [Maker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/guides/maker.md): `mj-zana/maker` generates code that follows the module layout.
- [Media](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/guides/media.md): `mj-zana/media` (2.2) handles the images editors upload.
- [Mediator](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/guides/mediator.md): `mj-zana/mediator` sends commands and queries to their handlers through pipeline behaviours, the CQRS style.
- [Outbox](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/guides/outbox.md): `mj-zana/outbox` (2.13) delivers events reliably.
- [Queue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/guides/queue.md): `mj-zana/queue` runs work in the background.
- [Routing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/guides/routing.md): `mj-zana/routing` maps HTTP methods and paths to handlers.
- [Scheduler](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/guides/scheduler.md): `mj-zana/scheduler` (2.2) runs recurring tasks from a single cron entry.
- [Security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/guides/security.md): `mj-zana/security` provides password hashing, signed bearer tokens, authentication middleware, and authorization by roles, permissions and policies.
- [Serialization](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/guides/serialization.md): `mj-zana/serialization` turns objects into arrays and JSON, and hydrates typed objects from arrays and JSON through their constructors, collecting every error on the way.
- [Sessions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/guides/session.md): `mj-zana/session` (2.2) stores server-side sessions for websites.
- [Testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/guides/testing.md): `mj-zana/testing` tests Zana applications with PHPUnit.
- [Translation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/guides/translation.md): `mj-zana/translation` translates interface strings and knows the locale of the current request.
- [Validation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/guides/validation.md): `mj-zana/validation` checks objects against constraint attributes and reports every violation with its path.
- [Views](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/guides/view.md): `mj-zana/view` renders HTML pages from templates with layouts, partials and escaping by default.

## Cookbook

- [A back office](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/cookbook/back-office.md): A company website needs a place where staff edit the news, the services or the team page without a developer.
- [The module cookbook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/cookbook/modules.md): Zana applications are built from **modules**.
- [Recipes for content sites](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/cookbook/recipes.md): Short, tested solutions for the things a company website or blog needs once its pages exist.
- [A company website](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/cookbook/website.md): Most first projects are not APIs but a company website.

## Contributing

- [Contributing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/contributing.md): Thank you for helping with Zana.
- [Security policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjnable/zana-docs/2.19/SECURITY.md): How to report a security problem in Zana privately, and how fixes are released.
